HAIM: Human-AI Music Dataset
	

Human-AI Music Datasets for AI Music Production Tracking Benchmark




Beyond binary "AI-or-human" — granular, role-level tracking of AI intervention across the music production workflow.


As generative platforms like Suno and Udio reach human-grade audio quality, AI now touches every stage of music production — not just full-song generation. HAIM moves detection beyond binary "AI-or-human" toward role-level tracking (Composer / Lyricist /… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mippia/HAIM.
